title: Sign in and reach the correct dashboard
description: This verifies that a user can log in with valid credentials and be routed to the appropriate dashboard afterward.

steps.description: Fill username into the username field
Fill password into the password field
Verify the appropriate dashboard is displayed

title: Request an immediate transfer export for selected workers
description: This verifies that an admin can select a salary month, choose eligible workers, and generate an immediate-transfer XML export successfully.

steps.description: Click the immediate transfer export flow
Verify the immediate-transfer XML file download is triggered
Verify the export is completed for the selected workers

title: Export SEPA XML for selected workers
description: This verifies that an admin can select eligible workers for a salary month and generate the SEPA XML export successfully.

steps.description: Open the SEPA XML export flow
Verify the XML file download is triggered
Verify the export flow completes for the selected workers

title: Upload a document and request a signature
description: This verifies that an admin can add a document, preview it, request a signature, and see the document status update afterward.

steps.description: Request a signature for the document
Verify the document status updates to a signature-requested state
Verify the uploaded document remains available in the list

title: Approve a time-entry correction
description: This verifies that an admin can review a worker's time logs for a selected month and approve a correction request.

steps.description: Verify the correction is marked as approved
Verify the reviewed time logs remain visible

title: Upload a new document and see it added to the list
description: This verifies that an admin can upload a new document and see it appear in the documents list afterward.

steps.description: Wait for the documents list to refresh
Verify the new document appears in the documents list
Verify the upload is reflected in the document list

title: Review salary values for a selected month
description: This verifies that an admin can choose a salary month and see the expected and actual salary values for workers in that month.

steps.description: Verify the workers' salary values for the selected month are displayed
Verify expected and actual salary information is visible

title: Adjust amounts before exporting SEPA XML
description: This verifies that an admin can change individual payment amounts before generating the SEPA salary export and the download still completes.

Verify the adjusted amount is accepted in the export flow

Wait for the reconciliation view to update

Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the login password field
Verify the correction is marked as approved

Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the login password field

Verify the salary record shows the updated justification
Verify the change remains visible in the selected month view

Wait for the reconciliation view to update

Verify the updated reconciliation state is visible

description: This verifies that workers with no expected salary amount for the selected month are not included in the immediate transfer export selection.

Click the immediate transfer export flow
Verify workers without expected salary amounts are not shown for selection
Verify only eligible workers can be selected

description: This verifies that workers without an expected salary amount do not appear in the SEPA export list for the selected month.

Open the SEPA XML export flow
Verify workers without an expected salary amount are not listed for export
